markdown:
The curse of the wereshark in stills a crude and bloodthirsty attitude, along with an urge to travel the sea. They often become pirates or military sailors who quickly gain a reputation for capricious violence. The shark within makes weresharks born survivors. They will swiftly retreat if they're truly in danger and consider obeying a sense of honor utterly ridiculous. **[Recall Knowledge - Beast](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)** ([Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=35), [Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=43)): DC 19 **[Recall Knowledge - Humanoid](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)** ([Society](/Skills.aspx?ID=47)): DC 19 **[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 17 **[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 14 [Wereshark](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3324) **Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 197 **Perception** +10; blood scent, [scent](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=74) ([imprecise](/Rules.aspx?ID=412)) 100 feet **Languages** [Common](/Languages.aspx?ID=1); shark empathy **Skills** [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=36) +12, [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=48) +9, [Survival](/Skills.aspx?ID=49) +8 **Str** +4 **Dex** +3 **Con** +4 **Int** -1 **Wis** +2 **Cha** -1 **Blood Scent** The wereshark can smell blood in the water from up to 1 mile away.
**Shark Empathy** ([primal](/Traits.aspx?ID=676)) A wereshark can communicate with sharks. **Items** [studded leather](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1774), [Trident](/Weapons.aspx?ID=45) --- **AC** 21 **Fort** +12 **Ref** +11 **Will** +8 **HP** 75 **Weaknesses** [silver](/Equipment.aspx?ID=379) 5 **[Reactive Strike](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=48)** --- **Speed** 25 feet, swim 25 feet **Melee** jaws +14, **Damage** 1d12+7 piercing plus curse of the wereshark **Melee** trident +14, **Damage** 1d8+7 piercing plus fish fork **Ranged** trident +13 ([thrown 20 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=195)), **Damage** 1d8+7 piercing **Change Shape** ([Concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [Polymorph](/Traits.aspx?ID=127), [Primal](/Traits.aspx?ID=134)) Medium human with fist +14 for 1d4+7 bludgeoning, or Large shark with jaws +14 for 1d12+7 piercing, no land Speed, and swim Speed 40 feet. The wereshark doesn't have the [amphibious](/Traits.aspx?ID=529) trait in human or shark form and has the [aquatic](/Traits.aspx?ID=533) trait in shark form. **Curse of the Wereshark** ([Curse](/Traits.aspx?ID=38), [Primal](/Traits.aspx?ID=134)) Saving Throw DC 18 Fortitude **Fish Fork** **Requirements** The wereshark critically hit with a trident Strike on their most recent action this turn; **Effect** The wereshark digs their trident deep within their target, skewering it before taking a massive bite. The target of the Strike becomes [grabbed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=77) ([Escape](/Actions.aspx?ID=2296) DC 18) and takes 1d4 [persistent bleed damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29), and the wereshark attempts a jaws Strike against it. The wereshark can't use their trident while they have a creature grabbed with it, but they can pull the trident free with a single action that has the [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645) trait. **Moon Frenzy** ([Polymorph](/Traits.aspx?ID=127), [Primal](/Traits.aspx?ID=134))
